implementation.targetScope: ProseMirror transform 1.12.5 position mapping, reversible steps, mark restoration, schema-aware edits and range fitting; Tiptap 2.11.7 application command controls against transform 1.12.5 and app 1.11.0. Complete editor integration, IME and collaborative server acceptance are separate. Empty-paragraph range deletion is repaired and checked with 96 caller variants. Nested-list suffix and cursor regressions are repaired, with 192 empty/nonempty-tail deletion and 256 repeated-text replacement variants. General cross-depth structural joining remains a documented follow-up.

changes: Independent schema-automaton fitting over persistent subtrees and boundary events, preserving untouched content.

Compatible list suffixes join without flattening nested lists; empty text tails retain the insertion cursor before reconstructed shells. Verified by 64 variants, expanded caller fuzzing, EditorState undo and packed Tiptap browser checks.

Range expansion requires a genuinely shared container or sibling textblocks, preserving an unselected empty paragraph at a nested selection boundary. Document, mapped cursor, undo and packed Tiptap callers verified.
After joining textblocks, carried structural suffixes retain their original nesting; a whole carried textblock may still fill a shallower parent when no left textblock was open.
Empty/repeated text tails are anchored by their source boundary before validating the reconstructed replacement; equal inserted text cannot select an earlier cursor position.
Mirrored mapping supports undo and rebasing; mark inverses restore prior formatting rather than blindly toggling it.
Serialized step positions must be nonnegative safe integers; step registration uses a Map, so inherited names cannot select constructors.
One VPM runtime dependency: vprosemirror-model 1.25.12. No upstream runtime files shipped.
